title: Sign in
ui: Email sign-in area; Google identity button; recovery link
api: Android Credential Manager then verified parent OIDC session
rule: OIDC does not establish adult or lawful guardian identity
accept: Canceled sign-in leaves user logged out; server verifies issuer and audience.

title: Create account
ui: Name; email; password or Google; terms; privacy
api: OIDC onboarding; principal+family binding after verification
rule: Do not attach existing child with client-supplied family ID
error: Duplicate principal; incomplete fields; auth error
accept: Family created only once after verified principal.

title: Google account handoff
ui: Account chooser; profile indicator; guardian disclosure
api: Credential Manager verified ID token, nonce and backend session
rule: Google account is NOT DPDP verifiable parent proof
accept: Separate verification pending state, no family data leaked.

title: Home dashboard
ui: Child switcher; map preview; location timestamp; battery; accuracy
api: Backend latest-qualified observation+health; auth per child
rule: Never request fresh GPS just because parent opens map
error: Offline; old fix; no location consent
accept: Stale badge and unknown position shown accurately.

title: Child details
ui: Linked device; Android version; battery; heartbeat; mode
rule: STANDARD is not managed; show report timestamp
accept: Capability and last contact separate, no fabricated live claim.

title: Install child app
hero: Install Alarka on the child's Android phone
ui: On child's phone install app; open visible setup; check OS
api: Local onboarding wizard then capability precheck
rule: Cannot remotely install app or silently grant child permissions
error: App absent; wrong Android API; no Play

title: Pair child device
ui: One-time code; QR optional; 10-min expiry countdown
rule: PAIR_DEVICE scope; code hashes, one use, no log secrets
accept: ACTIVE device only after valid Keystore proof.

title: Data-purpose review
ui: Live location separate from history and usage; approved adults
api: Purpose-version receipts and guardian verification not yet implemented
rule: Real minors disabled until signed India DPDP legal review
error: Guardian conflict; missing notice; purpose OFF
accept: Checkbox never substitutes for lawful parental verification.

title: Parent permission coach
ui: Location; notifications; battery; usage OFF; managed optional
api: Child POST signed capability; parent reads status
rule: Parent cannot remotely grant Android OS permission
accept: Only fresh child report marks a permission granted.

title: Location permission walkthrough
ui: Open child's app info; choose location permission; return and test
api: Child launches Settings; onResume rechecks actual permission state
rule: OS background rules still apply after grant
accept: Never mark enabled based only on opened settings.

title: Battery settings walkthrough
ui: Explain OS battery restriction; allow user choice; recheck
api: Child package battery-intent + health capability report
rule: No bypass of Doze or manufacturer limits
error: OEM UI differs; setting denied; device offline
accept: Parent shows observed setting and stale/unknown if unavailable.

title: Setup/device verification
ui: Android API; enrolled key; heartbeat; notifications; permissions
rule: Only OS-proven MANAGED_DEVICE_OWNER label; no fake DPC
error: No heartbeat; revoked credential; stale response

title: Travel history overview
ui: Day filter; segmented map; stops; quality legend
api: M3 trip/segment revision reads from C++ event-time worker
rule: History OFF for minors until separate legal review
error: GPS gap; low accuracy; late event
accept: No invented paths or 'precise road' guess.
